extra.message: SQL query built by inserting a value into the query text

metadata.title: SQL query built by inserting a value into the query text
metadata.explanation: This query is built by putting a value straight into the SQL string. If that value comes from a user, they can change the query itself (SQL injection) and read or delete data they shouldn't. Pass values separately and let the database driver fill in the placeholders safely.

references.title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet

extra.message: Shell command built from a variable

metadata.title: Shell command built from a variable
metadata.explanation: `exec` runs its string through the system shell. If part of it comes from a user, input like `; rm -rf ~` runs as a second command (command injection). Use `execFile` or `spawn` with an array of arguments so no shell interprets them.

references.title: OWASP OS Command Injection Defense Cheat Sheet
